intro-kop: Your hotel in Venray, close to Overloon
intro-p1: Hotel Asteria is at Maasheseweg 80a in Venray, about 10 minutes by car (9 km) from Overloon. The drive to Oorlogsmuseum Overloon, the Overloon War Museum, takes 9 minutes, to ZooParc Overloon 11 minutes. You stay in a four-star hotel right on the A73, park free of charge at the door and have our own wellness area with four saunas on the top floor.
intro-p2: Heavy fighting took place around Overloon in the autumn of 1944. The War Museum stands on that battlefield, and three war cemeteries nearby can be visited on the same day: the Commonwealth cemeteries in Overloon and Venray and the German war cemetery in Ysselsteyn. If you would rather see animals, head to ZooParc. Hotel Asteria is an independent hotel in Venray; tickets for the museum and ZooParc are sold there, or choose the War Museum package.

faq-1-1-v: How far is Hotel Asteria from the Overloon War Museum?
faq-1-1-a: 9 minutes by car, about 6 kilometres to the museum car park. Parking there is free; from the car park it is a walk of about 350 metres to the entrance.
faq-1-2-a: 11 minutes by car, about 10 kilometres. ZooParc is open every day of the year; allow three to four hours for a visit.
faq-1-3-v: Can I cycle from the hotel to Overloon?
faq-1-3-a: Yes. Overloon is about 6 kilometres by bike, roughly 25 minutes. At the hotel your bike can stay in a locked bike shed.
faq-2-1-v: Is there a package with the War Museum?
faq-2-1-a: Yes, the War Museum package: one night in a Comfort room, admission to the museum with coffee or tea in the museum café, a three-course dinner and the breakfast buffet. Let us know the day of your museum visit and we reserve your tickets.
faq-2-2-v: Can I park at the hotel?
faq-2-2-a: Yes, free of charge, right on the A73 (exit 8, Venray-Noord). There are four charging points for electric cars.
faq-2-3-v: Does the hotel have its own wellness area?
faq-2-3-a: Yes, at the top of the building: 300 m² with four saunas, a steam cabin and a plunge and herbal bath. Open Monday to Thursday 4 pm-10 pm and Friday to Sunday 12 noon-10 pm. Hotel guests pay € 12.50 per person; reserve your time in advance at reception.
